$comment: Executable definition of 'Doctrina actually works'. `doctrina verify` runs these in order; CI and the verification gate rely on them. The framework dogfoods its own build/verify command here. These MATCH the gates action.yml runs, so a green `doctrina verify` means a green CI — a local set weaker than CI's is a gate the author never runs. The `test` check carries an `expect` guard because `node --test` prints 'pass 0' and exits 0 when it matches no test files: an exit code answers 'did the runner crash', never 'did the runner run anything'.
